title: Parse the actual CardDemo JCL and procedures
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of jcl_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Every one of the 46 pinned main and extension JCL paths has an explicit disposition: 45 parse into bounded job plans and CREASTMT.JCL is the sole accepted-unsupported correction, pinned by its file digest and exact orphan DD continuation.
The two cataloged procedures parse with PROC/PEND wrappers, default and invocation symbols, qualified DD overrides, JCLLIB orders, and procedure-definition plus invocation-line provenance.

Fixed-width records ignore columns 73-80 for control parsing, padded and implicit instream delimiters work, and 243 continuations, five SET symbols, 12 conditions, 24 concatenations, 86 instream DDs, and 591 control/data records retain bounded source spans.
Malformed text, missing procedures, empty input, and source-size exhaustion fail with stable typed errors. Unknown operations remain unsupported and cannot become generic success.
